name: AgentFlow Pipeline
description: Git hotspot search and Git/GitHub repo delivery framework. Use for Git 热点搜索 with source/project links, Git case Lark/TG callbacks, and scaffold/probe/publish/monitor lifecycle; use the separate article-hotspot package for blog/content workflows.

host_root.description: Path to the host project root (cases/, workspaces/, trends/)

auto_promote.description: Enable level-B auto-promote from scheduled Git hotspot searches into GitHub repo delivery cases

lark_integration_mode.description: standalone_webhook uses LARK_WEBHOOK_URL fallback; openclaw_lark_channel delegates Lark App messaging and interactive cards to the official @larksuite/openclaw-lark plugin.

openclaw_lark_plugin.description: Companion OpenClaw Feishu/Lark channel plugin required for Lark App mode.

scaffold.description: Generate a GitHub repo delivery case skeleton

lark_callback.description: Handle OpenClaw-forwarded Git case Lark actions with git_case_* vocabulary
